p: Kingston may start again at guard next week, but it is not confirmed.
He played well in his first start, but the starting job isn't locked in, which matters for offensive line and run-game outlook.
whether or not he goes again next week, I know that he'll be ready
Kingston will be the guard in practice and is the next man up at guard while Savaiinaea is in the concussion protocol.
He is stepping into an expanded OL role, which matters for Miami's run-blocking.
